test_title: PYST 2:SSC CGL 2023 - Reasoning (Held On:14 Jul 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that represents the letters that, when placed from left to right in the following blanks, will complete the letter-series.

_ V J R W B _ _ R W B V L _ _ B V _ _ W

options.text: A V K R W M R
A W K R X N R
B V K R W M R
B W K R W M R

solution:
• A V K R W M R → **A** V J R W B **V K** R W B V L **R W** B V **M R** W
 
• A W K R X N R → **A** V J R W B **W K** R W B V L **R X** B V **N R** W
 
• B V K R W M R&nb
